fixed_context.semantic_model: Qwen3-8B Q4_K_M, one shared local llama.cpp runtime, non-thinking
fixed_context.s2s_model: qwen3-omni-flash-realtime-2025-12-01; provider connectivity smoke retained separately
fixed_context.voice_endpoint: instrumented reference renderer/audio-buffer proxy, not physical speaker onset
fixed_context.downstream_agent: one external deterministic Reference Agent process shared by both candidates
fixed_context.task_authority: same logical Task/run binding and oracle for both candidates
fixed_context.changed_axis: VIA-owned Agent client executes in a supervised worker process for A and in the Core process for B
fixed_context.semantic_routing_policy: direct, delegate, control, clarification, active-Task follow-up/status and pending-question invariants are serialized in the shared prompt
fixed_context.trace_contract: VIA-TRACE-v1 records all six QA-61 relation groups, using explicit N/A where a relation does not apply

execution_order: A/B is interleaved per case and trial; first candidate alternates.

aggregation.latency: nearest-rank p95 per case, then maximum case p95
aggregation.change_locality: mean unique changed Architecture Element IDs across the full frozen pack
aggregation.blast_radius: maximum excess affected independent user-visible units
aggregation.memory: nearest-rank p95 of candidate-owned process RSS plus the one shared local semantic runtime
aggregation.trace: 100 * complete scored records / all scored records
aggregation.reproduction: 100 * exactly reproduced reported metrics / all 18 pre-QA-62 table rows

failure_treatment: All errors and timeouts remain in raw data and fail applicable predicates.
source_reuse: Common executions are stored once and mapped to A/B by source_execution_key.

QA-01.method: delegated cases; shared semantic span plus candidate bridge and renderer proxy

QA-03.method: Agent source event to bridge receipt and renderer proxy

QA-05.method: control input to correct disposition presentation

QA-41.method: N-05 process-tree RSS plus shared semantic runtime

QA-51.method: excess protected-information units in Agent payloads

QA-62.method: clean analyzer exact reproduction of all 18 reported rows

limitations: Voice timing uses an instrumented renderer/audio-buffer proxy, not physical acoustic loopback; it is not PRODUCT_E2E.
The external Reference Agent is deterministic and does not measure real Agent reasoning quality or execution time.
The complete table determines DP-to-QA usefulness; it is not an Architecture winner selection.
One semantic-model execution per input case is reused for both candidates because DP-11 does not change the semantic path.
QA-21/22/23 are Architecture Element ledgers rather than runtime measurements.
QA-62 remains unscored until the independent analyzer reproduces all other rows.
